title: 制作一个4×4的网格符合年代的风格
prompt: Make a 4×4 grid starting with the 1880s. In each section, I should appear styled according to that decade (clothing, hairstyle, facial hair, accessories). Use colors, background, & film style accordingly.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松打造复古风格的 4×4 网格布局，适合怀旧主题网站、游戏界面或数字艺术创作，带来浓郁的像素风和 80 年代美学体验。
